name: traut-site
description: Eric Traut's archived iWeb travel site, ported to Astro: 31 pixel-identical routes rendered by real Astro layouts and components

scripts.prebuild: python3 scripts/extract_pages.py && python3 scripts/mirror_archive.py && python3 scripts/sync_styles.py --check
scripts.postbuild: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); from mirror_archive import relink_dist_archive, publish_welcome_alias; relink_dist_archive(); publish_welcome_alias()"
